author: Claude
method: Gaps observed while reading sources for batch 01 and the expanded brief list. Each has a distinct reader task and a named primary source; none is drafted, and sources marked 'not yet read' must be fetched before drafting. No search volumes or ranks.

candidates.task: Interpret Scheduling Assistant blocks (busy, tentative, outside working hours, no information) and fix missing free/busy for an attendee.
candidates.sourceStatus: read for colours only; the fetch did not explain 'no information' causes, so a second Microsoft source is needed
candidates.overlapRisk: google-calendar-find-a-time-blank-is-not-free (different provider; acceptable if Microsoft-specific causes are sourced)

candidates.task: Recipient removes a shared calendar from their list vs owner revoking access; what the My organization default leaves behind.
candidates.overlapRisk: taking-back-a-calendar-you-shared is Google/Cloud Calendars focused; merge if the Microsoft difference is only one paragraph

candidates.task: Set up paid Google appointments and understand cancellation/refund boundaries before accepting payments.
candidates.overlapRisk: Merge with booking verification (11902347) if each alone is thin. Payment terms must be quoted exactly; no financial advice.

candidates.task: Change an appointment schedule's hours or duration and determine what happens to already-booked appointments.
candidates.overlapRisk: Adjacent to google-appointment-schedule-which-calendars-block-booking-slots; publish only if existing-booking consequences are documented.

candidates.task: Read Time Insights meeting-hour categories without treating them as productivity measurements.
Control who can see events Gmail adds automatically (flights, reservations) on a shared calendar.
candidates.overlapRisk: google-calendar-event-visibility-private-public-default; distinct because Gmail-created events have their own default visibility setting (verify).

candidates.task: Organiser setting to allow or disallow new time proposals in Outlook and how an attendee proposes one.
candidates.source: Microsoft Support page on proposing a new meeting time (URL not yet located)
candidates.overlapRisk: keeping-track-of-who-replied covers Google/Apple proposals only; Outlook organiser-side control would be distinct.

candidates.task: Choose a shared mailbox calendar versus delegation for a team inbox such as reception or support.
candidates.source: Microsoft Learn shared mailbox documentation (not yet read)
candidates.overlapRisk: outlook-group-calendar-versus-shared-calendar; merge if shared mailbox calendars add only one decision row.

candidates.task: Choose between hiding, unsubscribing and deleting a Google calendar without destroying an owned schedule.
candidates.overlapRisk: Coordinate with Codex (secondary-calendar ownership) and unwanted-calendar-events-iphone before claiming.

rejected.topic: Separate Google working-location and out-of-office pages
rejected.reason: Merged into one decision page to avoid self-cannibalisation.

rejected.topic: Google invitations in other calendar services (15077640)
rejected.reason: Source covers email filtering only; RSVP-recording claims would be unsupported.
